title: Creamy Braised White Beans
description: A rich and comforting vegetarian bean dish made with chickpeas, white beans, whole milk, garlic, and herbs, perfect with crusty bread.

ingredients.name: Aleppo pepper or red pepper flakes

steps.instruction: Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the halved garlic, cut side down, and cook until golden brown, about 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the whole milk, chickpeas with their liquid, white beans, thyme, and ground nutmeg.
Season generously with salt and black pepper, then stir to combine.
When the mixture begins to bubble gently around the edges, reduce the heat to low and simmer for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Remove the garlic halves and let them cool slightly, then squeeze or scoop the softened cloves from their skins.
Spread the roasted garlic onto the crusty bread or toast.
If you prefer a thicker, stew-like consistency, mash some of the beans with a spoon or potato masher.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt and pepper.
Serve in bowls with a drizzle of olive oil, grated Parmesan, Aleppo pepper or red pepper flakes, and the garlic toast alongside.
